(()=>{const out={};for(const tr of [14,15,1]){for(const car of ['merc','c22','ferr']){PT8.launch({mode:'mp',track:tr,laps:1,humans:[{id:car,alt:0}],ai:[],trackRace:true});const c=RACE.cars[0];c.ai={skill:1,lat:0,name:'T'};const ip0=PT8.inPost;PT8.inPost=(cc,dt)=>{if(cc.human){const a=PT8.aiInput(cc,dt);cc.in={th:1,br:0,st:window.NOST?0:a.st,hb:0}}if(ip0)ip0(cc,dt)};const r={};let t=0;for(let i=0;i<60*40;i++){step(1/60);if(RACE.state==='count'){RACE.state='race';c._rollAI=0;c.forceAI=0}t+=1/60;const m=c.sp*2.237;for(const g of [30,60,100,130])if(m>=g&&!r[g])r[g]=+t.toFixed(1)}PT8.inPost=ip0;out[tr+'_'+car]=JSON.stringify(r)+' top'+Math.round(c.cs.top*2.237);PT8.cleanupRace()}}return JSON.stringify(out)})()
